title: ePICRucioMetadataTags
description: Optimized metadata tags for ePIC Rucio datasets using searchable slugs.

software_release.description: Container version tag (e.g. 26.03.0-stable, nightly, unstable, or default)

q2_min_gev2.description: Minimum Q2 value (GeV^2). Optional - not applicable to all datasets.

q2_max_gev2.description: Maximum Q2 value (GeV^2). Optional - not applicable to all datasets.

is_background_mixed.description: True if the sample includes background mixing; false if it is a regular/pure signal sample.

gun_particle.description: Single particle type. Optional - only applicable to single particle datasets.

gun_momentum_min_gev.description: Minimum particle gun momentum (GeV). For fixed-energy runs, equals gun_momentum_max_gev.

gun_momentum_max_gev.description: Maximum particle gun momentum (GeV). For fixed-energy runs, equals gun_momentum_min_gev.

gun_theta_min_deg.description: Minimum polar angle (degrees) for particle gun angular distribution.

gun_theta_max_deg.description: Maximum polar angle (degrees) for particle gun angular distribution.

gun_phi_min_deg.description: Minimum azimuthal angle (degrees) for particle gun distribution. Default is 0.

gun_phi_max_deg.description: Maximum azimuthal angle (degrees) for particle gun distribution. Default is 360.

gun_distribution.description: Angular distribution type for particle gun.

requester_dsc.description: Detector Subsystem Collaboration requesting the dataset. Optional.
